description.narrative: The overall objective of the project called FUTURE Developing green driven society and sustainable environmental CSOs in Bosnia and Herzegovina is to strengthen environmental governance by building the capacity and empowerment of environmental civil society organizations (ECSOs) and networks to effectively participate in the national and regional agenda for environment as change agents in advocating and influencing environmental policy development and implementation for better natural resource management and environmental protection. The FUTURE project will built upon results achieved within the recently closed NEST project, implemented by REC since 2021. The specific objectives of the project are: To build capacities, increase knowledge and technical background of ECSOs which will enable them to become a valued partners and transformative/change agents in environmental governance able to effectively advocate and contribute to policy development for main environmental challenges from local to national levels as well as to contribute to EU integration and negotiations processes in BIH. To enhance organizational capacities of ECOs and enabling platform for improvement of government accountability, environmental transparency and environmental governance. To improve management and effectiveness of the existing protected areas through strengthening cooperation and dialogue with ESCOs and thus create preconditions for expansion of protected areas network and establishment of new protected area. To strengthen professional capacities of judiciary and law enforcement officials for processing the most complex environmental cases and implementation of EU Environmental crimes legislation, as one of the basic preconditions on the path towards European integration. To improve multiagency networking established within the NEST project through experience and best practices exchange with other organizations and networks (INTERPOL, IMPEL, EUFJE and ENPE) in order to support BiH for ensuring effective transposition, harmonization, implementation and enforcement of EU environmental laws.

Att stärka miljöstyrningen genom att bygga upp kapaciteten och bemyndigandet hos miljöorganisationer inom det civila samhället och nätverk för att effektivt delta i den nationella och regionala agendan för miljön som förändringsagenter i att förespråka och påverka utveckling och genomförande av miljöpolitik för bättre naturresursförvaltning och miljö skydd.

To strengthen environmental governance by building the capacity and empowerment of environmental civil society organizations and networks to effectively participate in the national and regional agenda for environment as change agents in advocating and influencing environmental policy development and implementation for better natural resource management and environmental protection.
